claim: Human preferences are not identical to next-token likelihood; summarization used comparisons, learned reward and RL.
notes: Stiennon et al., 2020: summarization task, not general-purpose chat benchmark

claim: The InstructGPT training recipe consists of SFT, reward modeling from rankings and PPO.
notes: Three stages in the 2022 InstructGPT paper; diagram in this tutorial is independent

claim: InstructGPT RM predicts pair preferences with sigmoid(score difference), with grouped comparisons from 4–9 ranked outputs.
notes: The paper uses one grouped batch element per ranking, unlike naive independent pair training

claim: InstructGPT uses a 6B reward model, SFT as reference, per-token KL penalty and PPO; PPO-ptx mixes pretraining loss.
notes: Equation and model variants inspected; gamma=0 for PPO, not for PPO-ptx

claim: For 1.3B InstructGPT vs 175B GPT-3, human annotators preferred InstructGPT outputs on the paper's API prompt distribution.
notes: Human preference on the specified prompt distribution, not universal model capability

claim: The 175B InstructGPT was preferred to 175B GPT-3 85±3% and to few-shot GPT-3 71±4% in direct comparisons.
notes: Specific pairwise human preferences; avoid extrapolating beyond paper setup

claim: The InstructGPT prompt training dataset was over 96% English and labelers were about 40 selected contractors.
notes: Describes paper's dataset and annotator process, not all RLHF datasets

claim: An online iterated preference learning variant for helpfulness and harmlessness is explored in Bai et al. 2022.
notes: Not a feature of the original InstructGPT pipeline by default

claim: DPO is a later preference optimization alternative that removes an explicit RM+online RL loop in its training objective.
notes: Do not conflate DPO with PPO-based classical RLHF

claim: Pairwise sigmoid scores and discrete KL in mini_rlhf.py are deterministic toy calculations.
locator: Equation (1) and Equation (2); independently checked toy values
notes: Does not train an actual language model, RM or PPO policy

claim: PPO clipped surrogate uses probability ratios against an old policy distinct from the reference policy KL term.
locator: Schulman et al. 2017, Section 3; InstructGPT Eq. (2)
notes: Two separate algorithmic constraints; not to be equated
